blend_modes.formula: out = S + D * (1 - S.a) on all four premultiplied components (S already multiplied by the layer opacity). No formula B.
blend_modes.name: Normal

blend_modes.formula: Per pixel, taken or left: n = noise(x, y, layer id) (profile document 6.9); if S.a <= 0 or n >= S.a the backdrop stays; else the pixel becomes (S.rgb / S.a, 1): opaque source colour.
blend_modes.name: Dissolve

blend_modes.formula: As Dissolve (this revision does not vary the noise over time).
blend_modes.name: DancingDissolve

blend_modes.formula: B = min(b, s) per channel
blend_modes.name: Darken

blend_modes.formula: B = b * s
blend_modes.name: Multiply

blend_modes.formula: B = 1 if b >= 1; else 0 if s <= 0; else 1 - min(1, (1 - b) / s)
blend_modes.name: ColorBurn

blend_modes.formula: CLASSIC frame (profile document 6.9) with neutral 1: B = 0 if s' <= 0, else 1 - (1 - b) / s' (negative results are kept)
blend_modes.name: ClassicColorBurn

blend_modes.formula: B = max(0, b + s - 1)
blend_modes.name: LinearBurn

blend_modes.formula: B = the whole colour s if Y(s) < Y(b), else b; Y(c) = 0.2126 r + 0.7152 g + 0.0722 b
blend_modes.name: DarkerColor

blend_modes.formula: B = b + s
blend_modes.name: Add

blend_modes.formula: B = max(b, s) per channel
blend_modes.name: Lighten

blend_modes.formula: B = b + s - b * s
blend_modes.name: Screen

blend_modes.formula: B = 0 if b <= 0; else 1 if s >= 1; else min(1, b / (1 - s))
blend_modes.name: ColorDodge

blend_modes.formula: CLASSIC frame with neutral 0: B = 1 if s' >= 1, else min(1, b / (1 - s'))
blend_modes.name: ClassicColorDodge

blend_modes.formula: B = b + s
blend_modes.name: LinearDodge

blend_modes.formula: B = the whole colour s if Y(s) > Y(b), else b; Y as in DarkerColor
blend_modes.name: LighterColor

blend_modes.formula: B = HardLight with b and s exchanged: 2 b s if b <= 0.5, else s + (2 b - 1) - s (2 b - 1)
blend_modes.name: Overlay

blend_modes.formula: if s <= 0.5: B = b - (1 - 2 s) * b * (1 - b); else B = b + (2 s - 1) * (d - b) with d = ((16 b - 12) b + 4) b if b <= 0.25, else sqrt(max(b, 0))
blend_modes.name: SoftLight

blend_modes.formula: B = 2 b s if s <= 0.5, else b + (2 s - 1) - b (2 s - 1)
blend_modes.name: HardLight

blend_modes.formula: B = clamp(b + 2 s - 1, 0, 1)
blend_modes.name: LinearLight

blend_modes.formula: B = ColorBurn(b, 2 s) if s <= 0.5, else ColorDodge(b, 2 (s - 0.5))
blend_modes.name: VividLight

blend_modes.formula: B = min(b, 2 s) if s <= 0.5, else max(b, 2 s - 1)
blend_modes.name: PinLight

blend_modes.formula: B = 1 if b + s >= 1, else 0
blend_modes.name: HardMix

blend_modes.formula: B = |b - s|
blend_modes.name: Difference

blend_modes.formula: CLASSIC frame with neutral 0: B = |b - s'|
blend_modes.name: ClassicDifference

blend_modes.formula: B = b + s - 2 b s
blend_modes.name: Exclusion

blend_modes.formula: B = max(0, b - s)
blend_modes.name: Subtract

blend_modes.formula: B = b / s if s > 0; else 1 if b > 0, else 0
blend_modes.name: Divide

blend_modes.formula: B = SetLum(SetSat(s, Sat(b)), Lum(b))
blend_modes.name: Hue

blend_modes.formula: B = SetLum(SetSat(b, Sat(s)), Lum(b))
blend_modes.name: Saturation

blend_modes.formula: B = SetLum(s, Lum(b))
blend_modes.name: Color

blend_modes.formula: B = SetLum(b, Lum(s))
blend_modes.name: Luminosity

blend_modes.formula: The layer cuts everything below it: out = D * S.a on all four components (S multiplied by the layer opacity). No formula B.
blend_modes.name: StencilAlpha

blend_modes.formula: out = D * Y(S.rgb) on all four components, Y of the PREMULTIPLIED source colour (S multiplied by the layer opacity).
blend_modes.name: StencilLuma

blend_modes.formula: out = D * (1 - S.a) on all four components.
blend_modes.name: SilhouetteAlpha

blend_modes.formula: out = D * (1 - Y(S.rgb)) on all four components.
blend_modes.name: SilhouetteLuma

blend_modes.formula: out.rgb = S.rgb + D.rgb * (1 - S.a); out.a = min(1, S.a + D.a).
blend_modes.name: AlphaAdd

blend_modes.formula: out.rgb = S.rgb + D.rgb * (1 - S.a); out.a = S.a + D.a - S.a * D.a.
blend_modes.name: LuminescentPremul
